scenarios.name: a fresh field on the page: the mount announces an empty Value with Value Changed, then Did Mount; Enabled true, the three states false, Child Index 0, This itself
typing 'hi' into an unfocused field: the keyboard goes on it first (Focused), then one Value per key — 'h', 'hi' — and Value Changed twice; the frame's last Value is 'hi'
Enter in a focused field fires On Enter; Enter in an unfocused one puts the keyboard on it first (Focused) and fires On Enter
Enter in a Text Area fires On Enter and writes a newline into the field: Value gains a line break, Value Changed
Value from the graph while the field is on the page and unfocused: Value and Value Changed; the same Value again: nothing; null empties it; undefined is ignored
Value arriving while the person is typing (the field has the keyboard) is absorbed: nothing on the wire; a Set then is Unchanged; after a Blur action a Set lands: Done, Value, Value Changed

Run On Value Change off: a Value is stored and the field keeps what it shows; Set puts it in the field (Done, Value, Value Changed); a second Set is Done again and fires Value Changed again with nothing changed
Clear empties a field with text: Done, Value '', Value Changed; Clear again: Unchanged; Clear while the field has the keyboard still clears (Done)
a Number field: typing '42' publishes the number 42 (4, then 42); a letter is refused by the browser; Clear publishes null, Done; Clear again Unchanged
a Number field given Value '7' publishes 7; given 'abc' publishes null; given the number 5 publishes 5

a text field given the number 5 while on the page publishes '5' (text); given 6 while OFF the page publishes '6' (text) too — one type whatever the field's visibility (v3; was row D32: off the page it published the number 6)
Insert Text writes Text To Insert at the end: Done, Value, Value Changed; with Text To Insert empty: Unchanged; while the field has the keyboard it still writes (Done)
Backspace removes the last character at once: Done, Value, Value Changed; an emoji is one character; on an empty field: Unchanged

Max length 3: typing 'hello' stops at 'hel'; Insert Text 'xy' finds no room (Unchanged); a Backspace and an Insert 'xy' in one frame: the Insert finds the room the Backspace made and writes what fits ('hex', Done); a Value 'toolong' from the graph is not truncated — the runtime's Insert reads the text before the Backspace ('he', Unchanged: row C69)

Max length 3: typing 'hello' stops at 'hel'; Insert Text 'xy' finds no room (Unchanged); a Backspace, then in the next frame an Insert 'xy' writes what fits ('hex', Done); a Value 'toolong' from the graph is not truncated

Mounted off: Will Unmount, and Focused goes with the element — Focused false and Blurred (D30); a Value written while off the page is sent with no Value Changed; Mounted on: the mount announces it (Value Changed) and Did Mount; a quiet frame then changes nothing, and a Focus puts the keyboard back: Focused, Done
Mounted off and on with nothing written: Did Mount alone — the mount has nothing to announce (GAM-009)
typed text survives a remount: the field starts from what the person typed, and the mount announces nothing new
a disabled field takes no typing, no Enter, no press, no release and no focus — the pointer still hovers it, and a finger reports nothing (C64)

a mouse press on the field fires Pointer Down with Pressed true and puts the keyboard on it (Focused); the release fires Pointer Up with Pressed false; a click is the same pair (was row C68: the runtime's one-line field fired neither; fixed in P109 ISL-031)
a Text Area: a press fires Pointer Down with Pressed true and takes the keyboard; the release Pointer Up with Pressed false
the Focus action puts the keyboard in the field (Focused, Done); a second Focus is Done with nothing more; Blur takes it off (Blurred, Done); a Blur with nothing focused is Done alone
a Focus while the field is off the page is Unchanged and not kept; a Focus on a disabled field is Done and takes nothing

trace.message: Focus arrived while this field was not on the page, so nothing was focused. A Focus is not kept for later: send it once the field has mounted, for example from its row’s Did Mount

scenarios.name: typing while the field is off the page writes nothing: a person finds no field

focused, then Enable Label turned on: the field and the keyboard on it stay — a Focus action is Done with nothing more; turned off again, the same — the runtime rebuilds the input under the label and the keyboard leaves with the old one, silently (a Focus fires Focused again: was row C80, fixed in P109 ISL-031)
focused, then Type changed to Text Area: a <textarea> replaces the <input> and the keyboard leaves with it, silently; a Focus action takes it again
a text field holding 'abc' switched to Number: the element shows nothing (the value is sanitised) while Value still reads 'abc'; typing '5' then publishes 5, not 'abc5'
Set and Mounted off in one frame: the Set lands through the component first (Done, Value, Value Changed), then Will Unmount

two Sets and an Insert in one frame are answered in the order pressed: Done, Done (the second with nothing to change, still Done), then the Insert Done on the Sets' text ('si'); Value Changed three times — the runtime's Insert reads the field before the Sets ('i', row C69)
Backspace and Insert Text while the field is off the page edit the start value: Value sent at once with no Value Changed (Done); the mount then announces it
Text To Insert null reads as empty (Insert Unchanged); Text To Insert 5 reads as '5' (Insert Done, Value 'a5')
Enabled follows its input as a boolean and is sent only on a change: 0 disables, 'no' enables, a repeat is silent
Enabled off and typing in the same frame: the element is still enabled on the page, so the keys land; in the next frame typing finds a disabled field and nothing moves
Mounted written off and typing in the same frame: nothing to act on, the field has left the page; written on with typing in the same frame: Did Mount, the field is back and takes the keys
Placeholder, Input Mode, Enter Key Hint, Placeholder opacity, Text Horizontal Align, Label, Scroll Into View and every look or layout input change nothing on the wire
Font Family wired a number: treated as no family — nothing moves on the wire and the node keeps working

a person acts on a painted page: Mounted written off and an act in the same frame find no element (a Focus after it is Unchanged); written on, the act meets the element (a Focus after it is Done) — every act, both ways (was row C68: the runtime's one-line field fired neither; fixed in P109 ISL-031)

scenarios.name: a Focus before the first frame: the field was placed, so it is Done and takes the keyboard (Focused); the first frame then announces the Value and Did Mount
placed with Mounted off: a Focus before the first frame is Unchanged; nothing announces, no Did Mount; a quiet frame changes nothing

trace.message: Focus arrived while this field was not on the page, so nothing was focused. A Focus is not kept for later: send it once the field has mounted, for example from its row’s Did Mount

scenarios.name: focused, then Mounted off and on: the leaving takes the keyboard and Focused with it — Will Unmount, Focused false and Blurred (D30); Did Mount; a Focus action puts the keyboard on the element that came back and fires Focused; a Tab away then fires Blurred; a quiet frame changes nothing
focused; Mounted off, a release, Mounted on and typing in one frame: the field left and came back between the acts, so the typing puts the keyboard on the new element (Focused fires) before it writes
a Text Area: focused, then a press held across a frame (Pressed true, Pointer Down, no second Focused), then the release (Pressed false, Pointer Up)

a finger down and up in one frame: Pointer Down and Pointer Up, Pressed ends where it began; a finger held across a frame then a mouse click on the focused field: the click's release ends the press (Pressed false, Pointer Up) (was row C68: the runtime's one-line field fired neither; fixed in P109 ISL-031)

a Text Area: a finger down and up in one frame: Pointer Down and Pointer Up, Pressed ends where it began; a finger held across a frame then a mouse click on the focused field: the click's release ends the press (Pressed false, Pointer Up)
a Number field holding text that is not a number reads null; Backspace is Done three times while the text shrinks unseen, then Unchanged on the empty field
Mounted off and on with a typed value: Did Mount alone, then a quiet frame, then a Focus action Done — the remount is painted once
focused, then a pointer act (hover, leave, release, touch, lift) or a Tab away that finds nothing, each with a Focus action in the same frame: the keyboard stays, the Focus is Done alone

Mounted off, then Mounted on with a press in the same frame: Did Mount, Pressed and Pointer Down, and Focused (the press's mousedown default takes the keyboard); again with a Tab onto it (focus act): Did Mount and Focused; again disabled: Did Mount alone (was row C68: the runtime's one-line field fired neither; fixed in P109 ISL-031)

a Text Area: Mounted off, then Mounted on with a press in the same frame: Did Mount and Focused (the press's mousedown default takes the keyboard), nothing else; again with a Tab onto it (focus act): Did Mount and Focused; again disabled: Did Mount alone

a Number field: Value null, then Insert Text 'ab' puts text that is not a number in the field (Value stays null, Done); Clear reports Done — it empties the field's text, though the author's Value and the output were already empty (v4; was row D33: Unchanged) — so a Backspace then is Unchanged

a focused Number field: Value null, Insert Text 'ab', then Set — the keyboard is on the field, so Set lands only in the start value (Unchanged) and the field keeps 'ab'; Clear reads the field, not the start value: Done, and the field is empty

off the page with Run On Value Change off: a Value is stored; Clear is Done and empties it (the output, never set, reads empty); a Set then finds the output already reading the empty value (Unchanged); Mounted on: the mount announces the empty Value (Value Changed) and Did Mount

off the page with Run On Value Change off: a Value 'x' and a Set in one frame — the Set lands at the frame's end (Done, Value 'x' at once, no Value Changed) and the callback is consumed: a quiet frame answers nothing; Mounted on announces 'x' (Value Changed, Did Mount)
Run On Value Change off: Value 'a', Set (Done, Value 'a'), the same Value again (ignored), Set again (Done, Value Changed again with nothing changed); Value 'b' then Set: Value 'b'
Set and an Insert with nothing to insert in one frame: the Set lands a new value (Done, Value, Value Changed), the Insert is Unchanged

focused and a finger held across a frame, then Enable Label turned on and the finger lifted in the same frame: Pointer Up and Pressed false; the field keeps the keyboard, so a Focus action is Done alone — the runtime's rebuilt input lost it (Focused again: was row C80, fixed in P109 ISL-031)

focused, then disabled; an act on the disabled field (a press, click, key, Tab or finger takes nothing; the pointer's hover still reports); re-enabled, a Focus action is Done alone — the element still held the keyboard, the page never took it away — every act

on the page, then off it with Run On Value Change off: Value 'x' is stored; Clear is Done (the author's Value emptied; the output already read empty); a Set then is Unchanged — the output already reads the empty Value

a pointer act drains the frame: a Set and an empty Insert Text queued, then the act, then a Clear in the same frame — the Set lands at the act (Done, Value 'x', Value Changed) and the Insert is Unchanged there, the Clear then empties the field (Done, Value '') — hover, leave, release, click, touch, lift (was row C68: the runtime's one-line field fired neither; fixed in P109 ISL-031)

a Text Area: a pointer act drains the frame: a Set and an empty Insert Text queued, then the act, then a Clear in the same frame — the Set lands at the act (Done, Value 'x', Value Changed) and the Insert is Unchanged there, the Clear then empties the field (Done, Value '') — hover, leave, release, click, touch, lift
a Text Area's press drains the frame too: a Set and an empty Insert Text queued, the press, then a Clear — Set Done at the press, Insert Unchanged, Clear Done last; the release then fires Pointer Up

a press and a click drain the frame as every pointer act does, a Tab onto the field and a key do NOT: a Set queued, the act, then a Clear — after a press the Set lands at the act and the Clear runs last; after a Tab or a key the Clear runs first and the Set, at the frame's end, finds the keyboard on the field (Unchanged), each time (was row C68: the runtime's one-line press did not drain; fixed in P109 ISL-031)

a Text Area: an <input>'s press, a Tab onto the field and a key do NOT drain the frame: a Set queued, the act, then a Clear — the Clear runs first and the Set lands at the frame's end (Value 'x' wins), each time
focused, then a Set queued (it will be absorbed: the field has the keyboard), a hover and a Clear in one frame: the Set is answered Unchanged at the hover, before the Clear's Done

a pointer act drains the frame, one write at a time: a Set alone (Done, or Unchanged while the field has the keyboard) or an empty Insert Text alone (Unchanged) queued, the act, then a Clear — the queued press is answered at the act, before the Clear's Done — hover, leave, release, click, touch, lift, with the keyboard off and on the field (was row C68: the runtime's one-line field fired neither; fixed in P109 ISL-031)

a Text Area: a pointer act drains the frame, one write at a time: a Set alone (Done, or Unchanged while the field has the keyboard) or an empty Insert Text alone (Unchanged) queued, the act, then a Clear — the queued press is answered at the act, before the Clear's Done — hover, leave, release, click, touch, lift, with the keyboard off and on the field

a Value written off the page, then Mounted on and an act in the same frame: the act's paint remounts and announces the Value (Value Changed, Did Mount) before the act, and a Focus action after it finds the element — every act (was row C68: the runtime's one-line field fired neither; fixed in P109 ISL-031)

a Text Area, its press and click: a Value written off the page, then Mounted on and an act in the same frame: the act's paint remounts and announces the Value (Value Changed, Did Mount) before the act, and a Focus action after it finds the element — every act

the matrix: every act (a press or a click only on a disabled field), enabled or disabled, with the keyboard off or on the field, remounting in the act's frame or not (a Value written while off the page, announced by the remount), with nothing, a Set, an empty Insert Text or a writing Insert Text queued — then a Clear and a Focus action in the same frame

the matrix on a Text Area, a press or a click: enabled or disabled, with the keyboard off or on the field, remounting in the act's frame or not, with nothing, a Set, an empty Insert Text or a writing Insert Text queued — then a Clear and a Focus action in the same frame

the matrix's writing Insert Text queued behind a Clear: an act that does not drain the frame (a Tab, a key, typing, or a disabled field's press, release or click), enabled or disabled, with the keyboard off or on the field, remounting in the act's frame or not — the Clear empties the field and the Insert at the frame's end writes into the empty field — the runtime's Insert reads the text before the Clear (row C69)

Max length -0.5 is a limit of 0 (HTML reads the attribute's leading digits after a sign; -0 is not negative): typing lands nothing after the keyboard goes on; Insert Text 'ab' still writes (the component measures room only above 0); Max length -1 is no limit and '7' lands after the inserted text; Max length 0 refuses again

a write converts with the Type as it stands: Type Number and Clear in one frame publish null (the Number field's empty), Done; a Clear in the next frame is Unchanged; a Backspace on a field holding '3' in the frame Type turns Number publishes null — the runtime converts with the Type it last drew ('' twice: row C72)

an Insert Text's room is measured with the Max length as it stands: Max length 2 written with the Insert in one frame onto 'abcd' leaves no room (Unchanged), and the next frame's Insert none either — the runtime measures with the Max length it last drew and lets 'xy' through (row C72)

one write after another, with or without a turn of the event loop between: a Backspace then an Insert Text at the frame's end edits the shortened text ('ab0') with an advance of 0 ms between, and again without one ('ab0' from 'ab0'); a Clear then a Backspace is Unchanged, with an advance between or not — the runtime's Insert without the advance reads the text before the Backspace ('ab00') and its Backspace after a Clear puts text back (row C69)
a Backspace, an advance of 0 ms, then an Insert Text at the frame's end edits the shortened text ('ab0'); a Clear, an advance, then a Backspace is Unchanged

a Text Area's cursor rests at the END of its text: a Focus action then an Insert Text 'x' writes 'abcx'; typing 'y' goes in after it ('abcxy'); Backspace removes the 'y' before the cursor; after a Blur action the Insert still lands at the cursor ('abcxx') (was row D35: the runtime's Text Area rested it at the START, 'xabc'; fixed in P109 ISL-031)

an <input>'s cursor rests at the END: a Focus action then an Insert Text 'x' writes 'abcx'; a Value from the graph while unfocused moves the cursor to the end of the new text ('defx' after a Focus and an Insert)

a Type change from Email (no selection API) to Text puts the cursor at the START: 'a' typed into an Email field, Type Text, then Insert Text 'bc' writes 'bca'; typing 'z' then goes in after the inserted text ('bcza'); a Text Area made from it is a fresh element with its cursor at the end ('bczabc') (was row D35: the runtime's was at the start; fixed in P109 ISL-031)

a Type change from Email (no selection API) to Text puts the cursor at the START: 'a' typed into an Email field, Type Text, then Insert Text 'bc' writes 'bca'; typing 'z' then goes in after the inserted text ('bcza')

off the page, an Insert Text and a Set with no Value ever written in one frame: the Set makes no value empty text, as the field does on the page, so the output and the wire read '' (v3, P107-D32; v1–v2 emptied the getter to undefined, never sent, and the wire kept the Insert's '0'); a second Set is Unchanged (the output already reads it); Mounted on announces the empty field ('')

focused, then disabled; Enabled on and an act in the same frame, then a Blur action: the act's paint re-enabled the element, so the Blur takes the keyboard off it (Blurred, Done) — every act (a Tab away blurs it itself; the Blur after it is Done alone; a press or Enter lands on the re-enabled field) (was row C68: the runtime's one-line field fired neither; fixed in P109 ISL-031)

a Text Area: focused, then disabled; Enabled on and an act in the same frame, then a Blur action: the act's paint re-enabled the element, so the Blur takes the keyboard off it (Blurred, Done) — every act (a Tab away blurs it itself; the Blur after it is Done alone; a press or Enter lands on the re-enabled field)

off the page with a Value written, then an empty Insert Text and Mounted on in one frame: the frame's end answers the Insert Unchanged and puts the field back (Value Changed, Did Mount) — a quiet frame then changes nothing

off the page with Run On Value Change off: a Value 'x', a Set and an empty Insert Text in one frame — the Set lands (Done, Value 'x'), the Insert is Unchanged, and the callbacks are consumed: a quiet frame answers nothing

focused, then Type turned Text Area with a release, or a lift, in the same frame: the act's paint replaces the <input> with a <textarea> and the keyboard leaves with the old one (Pointer Up, no Blurred) — a Blur action after it finds nothing to blur (Done alone)

focused, then Type turned Text Area with a Set queued in one frame: the Set is absorbed (Unchanged — the field had the keyboard), the frame's end replaces the element and the keyboard leaves with the old one; a Blur action next frame finds nothing to blur (Done alone)

Block Pointer Events on: a release, a touch or a lift drains the frame BEFORE its own report — a Set queued, the act, then a Clear: the Set lands at the act (Done, Value) before Pointer Up or Pointer Down, then the Clear — enabled, and disabled too (a disabled field reports no release, touch or lift — C64 — but the browser's pointer event still reaches the blocker, which drains)

Block Pointer Events on: an Insert Text queued is drained by a release, a touch or a lift as a Set is — the insert, the act, then a Clear: the Insert lands at the act (Done, Value, Value Changed) and the Clear empties it after — enabled, and disabled too (no release, touch or lift reported on a disabled field — C64 — but the blocker still drains)

a Text Area with Block Pointer Events on: a press or a click drains the frame BEFORE its own report — a Set queued, the act, then a Clear: the Set is answered before Pointer Down (Done on the first press; Unchanged after it, the press having put the keyboard on the field) — enabled, and disabled too (a disabled field reports no press, but the pointer event still reaches the blocker)

Block Pointer Events on, a DISABLED field nobody has focused: a press or a click still drains the frame at the browser's pointer event — a Set (Done) or an Insert Text (Done with 'z', Unchanged with nothing to insert) queued, the act, then a Clear: the queued write is answered before the Clear
